---
title: "kplotrtf"
---

## Description

Generate Figure RTF Output.

Macro to generate an RTF file from a final statistical graphics procedure. The following macro variables must be defined before execution:

## Parameters

**`call`**

: Macro call type: OPEN or CLOSE

  *Required:* Yes

**`inds`**

: Input dataset name

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `&_oid.`

**`sortby`**

: Variable for sorting the input dataset

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `DATA for no sorting`

**`MaxPageDigits`**

: Number of digits in the last page indicator for 'Page X of Y'

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `1`

**`escapechar`**

: ODS Escape Character to be used

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `@`

**`debug`**

: Flag to save interim datasets for debugging purposes Y/N

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%plotrtf(call=OPEN,MaxPageDigits=3);
procsgplotdata=...
...
quit;
%plotrtf(call=CLOSE);
```
